## What's new

Threadnote 5.0.3 gives agents a concise Context Brief answer with two evidence cards and safe recovery, cutting its model-visible payload benchmark by 30.6–53.8%.

### More useful context with fewer model-visible bytes

Context Brief locate responses now lead with a concise answer while retaining two focused evidence cards, safe recovery guidance, explicit compatibility for both response formats, and real OMP compatibility.

In the exact installed evaluation, the Threadnote bytes/3 estimate for the agent locate payload fell from 2,374 bytes (about 792 byte-model tokens) to 1,648 bytes (about 550) at the 800 budget: a 30.6% reduction. At the 1,200 budget it fell from 3,568 bytes (about 1,190) to the same 1,648 bytes (about 550): a 53.8% reduction.

These are Threadnote's model-visible payload benchmark estimates, not a claim about provider-billed tokens.
